text: Jim stood in the back of the advanced yoga studio, sweating profusely. He had intended to join the beginner’s session, but a misread schedule had landed him in the "Advanced Lotus & Beyond" class. The instructor, a serene woman named Serenity, glided into a complex inversion. Jim attempted to mimic her, but his body had other plans. As he twisted into a pretzel, a loud, resonant noise echoed through the room. It wasn't just a grunt; it was a symphony of accidental toots that seemed to vibrate the very air. The other students, trying desperately to maintain their zen, began to twitch and giggle, their composure shattering. In the chaos, Jim looked around for support and locked eyes with a large, long-necked animal that had somehow wandered into the studio—a giraffe. The giraffe, known for its long neck, simply chewed its cud and watched, unimpressed by the human comedy unfolding before it.
